change: Only the 64 standalone Kmer3 frequencies: overlapping count/(L-3+1) versus overlapping count/L. All 15153 other columns, all 15217 names/order, and dimensions must be identical.

paper.definition: f(t)=N(t)/N; N is sequence length; paper calls this a 3-mer descriptor

fixed: 2968 records, labels, order, and sequence lengths
2451 sequence/locus groups and five outer/three inner folds
k=3, overlapping counting, all other feature values and all column names/order
six base models and CatBoost meta-model with no raw-feature passthrough
reported S1 effective settings, seed 20261014 and one CPU thread
software environment, training-only MLP StandardScaler and max_iter=2000
threshold 0.5, no tuning, no model selection
control_reuse: Verify original control artifact hashes and all 125 fit audits; reuse predictions without overwriting or rerunning.
primary: Pooled held-out combined-model accuracy difference: k3_paperL_full minus k3_full
secondary: Descriptive per-model and per-fold accuracy, mean fold AUROC, MCC, sensitivity, specificity
Paired label changes and corrected/introduced errors
Maximum absolute probability differences, changed probabilities and labels per base/meta model
OOF and outer-test probability differences by model to locate numerical sensitivity

uncertainty.method: Paired whole-group bootstrap within each fixed outer fold
uncertainty.interval: Percentile 95% for difference and each accuracy

audit.independent_counting: Python overlapping substring Counter checks independent integer base-4 implementation on all rows
audit.train_only_scaling_diagnostic: Compare standardized word blocks for every outer training and inner crossfit training split

expected_behavior: Because the changed block is a constant positive rescaling on fixed-length sequences, no new information is added. Exact-arithmetic order-based splits and per-feature standardization can be invariant, but finite-precision implementation effects must be measured rather than assumed.
limits: Exploratory follow-up after viewing prior benchmark results; not fresh independent confirmation.
This tests only the standalone 3-mer frequency denominator, not every normalization in the paper or other descriptor blocks.
All sequences have length 200: count/L is 0.99 times count/(L-2), with unchanged information and dimensionality.
Feature-family mapping, final ensemble choices and historical software remain unresolved; this is a repaired reconstruction, not exact reproduction.
Reported S1 settings may already have been selected using these labels.
Intervals condition on fitted predictions; no refitting, seed variation or parameter-selection uncertainty.
No historical contaminated test records or NEW_2026_DATA outcomes are used; no winning model is selected.
publication: Local only; no website edits, commits, pushes or deployment.
